interface.signature: findSwapValues(A: List[int], B: List[int], N: int, M: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The size of array A must be between 1 and 10^6.
The size of array B must be between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in B)
preconditions.description: All elements in arrays A and B must be integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if any((sum(A) - a + b == sum(B) - b + a) for a in A for b in B) else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output is 1 if there exists a pair (a, b) such that swapping a from A and b from B makes the sums equal, otherwise -1.
